feedback.caption: Found a bug? Missing something? It lands directly with the developer.
feedback.placeholder: What happened, or what would make this better?
feedback.shot_help: Sends a picture of the screen behind this window, exactly as it is now — this box is left out of it. Whatever the page shows, your figures included, goes with it.
feedback.shot_failed: This screen could not be captured; your comment will be sent without a picture.
feedback.shot_big: The picture came out too heavy to send; your comment will be sent without it.
feedback.shot_wait: One second — the picture is still being taken.
feedback.shot_paste: …or paste a screenshot into the box (Ctrl/⌘+V).
feedback.rate_limited: That's plenty for now — try again in a while.
feedback.failed: Could not save your feedback. Please try again later.
feedback.unsent: Not sent — copy this before you close.
